cards.text:
Subject: Five minutes before or after [Course] for a student group?

Dear Professor [Last name],

I represent AI Safety Nordhaven, a student group at Nordhaven University that deals with the safe development of AI systems. On Thursday 3 December at 18:30 we are holding an intro evening in lecture hall 2, open to students of every subject…

cards.label: Invitation to the mailing list
cards.text:
Subject: Intro evening on Thu 3 Dec: what is AI safety?

Hi,

are you interested in how we can design AI responsibly and safely? Then come to our intro evening:

Thursday 3 December, 18:30, lecture hall 2

You do not need any prior knowledge, and students of every subject are welcome.

Hi everyone 👋

We are holding an intro evening for people who are new to AI safety:

*Thursday 3 December, 18:30, lecture hall 2*

A short talk, time for questions, and snacks and a chat afterwards. No prior knowledge needed, every subject welcome, in English.
